official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – General approach

institution_roles.evidence_locator: PDF p. 1 Council masthead; section III paragraphs 1-2 attribute substantive preparation to the Czech Presidency. The Council association represents the Presidency acting within the Council, without implying Council adoption.
PDF p. 1 cover: From General Secretariat of the Council to Permanent Representatives Committee.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Coreper text forming the immediate basis for Council's general approach.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The Czech Presidency, acting within the Council, is the substantive drafter; the Council author association represents that Presidency origin and does not imply Council adoption. The General Secretariat is separately recorded as cover-note sender and Coreper is the recipient. Section VI invites Coreper agreement and a recommendation that the Council reach a general approach; this is not an already adopted Council position. The issue date remains 11 November 2022. Annex 6 of ST 15322/24 documents later disclosure on 28 October 2024, not first-ever publication.

document_date.locator: PDF p. 1 cover: Brussels, 11 November 2022; ST 14336/22.
document_date.meaning: The official PDF establishes the issue date of this exact Council note.

publication_date.locator: Annex 6 reply dated 28 October 2024; PDF p. 9 lists ST 14336/22 and p. 11 states that all listed documents are available in the public register and enclosed.
publication_date.meaning: The Council reply establishes documented later disclosure/public access on 2024-10-28, not first-ever publication.

classification_evidence.locator: PDF section III paragraphs 1-2, section V paragraph 2, section VI and Annex.
classification_evidence.rationale: The note and annex directly revise the proposed Artificial Intelligence Act for consideration by Coreper.

classification_evidence.locator: PDF subject and Annex setting out harmonised rules on artificial intelligence.
classification_evidence.rationale: The proposal is a horizontal AI framework rather than a single-sector instrument.
